purpose: Deep issue analysis, allocation-free equivalent predictor, realistic next-tick delivery and one fresh-within-deadline authority variant; no new training unless a separate later protocol is justified
causal_interface: Same frozen20 channels, removed14/15/16/17/19 remainzero. Simulation normal service is minimum10ms, never same-tick. Observation timestamp retained through queue; no configured latency or future response enters policy.
controller: One new variant: separate50ms freshness validity from authority. Under valid fresh packet, cap0.25 and ramp0.05/controltick; remove legacy exp(-0.8*(age_ms-5)). Same1s predictor, tau0.3 filter,0.1% predicted-cost margin,3goodticks, angle/rate limits and fallback. No safety theorem.
optimization: Replace array allocations/BLAS dispatch within100-step predictor by scalar recurrence with same equations and float64, no fastmath. Costs and actual controller commands validated against frozen v3 on randomized/closed-loop contracts before results. Original source/results untouched.
planner: Causal nonlearned5candidate nominal performance planner. Uses same observable estimated state, actuator, preview and supervisor history; predicts one current held-command tick then healthy next-tick delivery. No true friction, physical state beyond observable actuator, future noise, actual future completion or configured service input. Repeated-residual nominal forecast only. Not globally optimal, not a safety certificate or wall-time benchmark.
acceptance: Unchanged: PPO >=1% penalized lateral RMSE improvement over matched LQR, same-supervisor student and BOTH constants; all3 group gains vs student positive; no survival loss; nominal <=1.02LQR; overall heading and actuator-rate RMS <=1.05LQR; exact100ms fallback. Apply same screen descriptively to planner as a finite-headroom signal, not learned success.

timing.wait: portable platform timer, no tuned spin, original10ms targets and budgets unchanged
timing.fault: Crash injected by separate process outside monitor; actual death timestamp logged
timing.isolation: Linux parent highest allowed CPU, helpers next CPU and nice19 where supported; no host isolation or hard realtime claim
timing.heartbeat: Independent preallocated native monotonic absolute-sleep heartbeat,3x5s nominal and3x5s worker-core stress, no controller. Baseline context only, not equivalent full-system load.
timing.criterion: Any miss fails observed strict10ms; output commit timestamps after fallback handling. Functional checks and timing separate; no rebase, dropped ticks or forgiven misses. Run after development, not during training/evaluation.

reserved: Unopened unless PPO full development passes AND a corresponding-controller realworker timing stage passes with unchanged criteria; freeze a distinct confirmation manifest first. Native Webots confirmation conditional on that selection gate.
stop: Exactly one new authority/interface variant plus equivalent optimization and nonlearned planner. Publish all outcomes; no coefficient/horizon/threshold search, no new training in this stage. Physical laptop and vehicle require connected hardware. Broader references/full robust published algorithm remain separate limitations.
